notMapped.reason: No separate Experiment 1 (comprehension) file: exp_s007.csv and exp_s008.csv are identical and match Experiment 2's production proportions; the data has no objects/messages/choice index either.

exclusions: Load keeps every worker whose language field is English (case-insensitive; all 52 are). The paper's exclusion of the 15% of participants with the highest distractor-error rate on non-ambiguous trials is applied inside evaluation.evaluate, not here. Distractor trials are kept as role 'distractor' (evaluate drops them from the regression). Experiment 1's four speaker warm-up trials are not in the data.
